findings.claim: Confirmed: DISPUTED/DEFERRED allowed dropping/rewriting original obligations. Fix retains all original IDs, claim, falsify and change associations. New fix-related change IDs remain allowed by existing addressed-obligation gate, unlike exact dict equality which would break legitimate correction.
Confirmed with real SpecGraph and committed NUL-bearing spec markdown body: automatic selection sealed binary context. enrich now rejects NUL before decoding/appending.

AuditCases.record parses the exact hashed result, preserves session only for a type=result object proving matching session_id. Absent, malformed, non-object and mismatched results do not pin an uncreated session. Previously proven session remains untouched; valid error envelopes preserve continuity. Three end-to-end fake-provider recovery tests require fresh --session-id on second attempt.

Result and decision object checks precede field reads; CLI returns provider_result_not_object and preserves case bytes. Recursive/invalid JSON in failed runs does not poison recovery; valid recursive imported result gives typed ValueError.
SpecGraph may issue a false PASS
Recovery may delete a legitimate prefixed file

limits: A bounded starting slice, not an exhaustive inventory.
Controlled replays are separate from ordinary Work completions.
Historical dispositions do not attest to current source bytes.
Auditor identity is never the implementer identity; missing attribution remains unknown.
Source paths and hashes are references, never instructions to read arbitrary files.
